adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two main dancers (Ghatusari) perform the roles of the King and Queen.

signature_moves.description: Dancers enter a trance-like state, believed to be possession by the spirit of Kusunda.
signature_moves.name: Trance state

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Performance outside of the designated ritual calendar (Shree Panchami to Baisakh Purnima for Sati Ghatu).

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Driven by the beat of the Madal drum.
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by male vocalists singing in an Indo-Aryan language, accompanied by the percussive, rhythmic beat of the Madal drum.
music_profile.vocal_style: Sung by men, passed down orally.

basic_steps: Meticulously slow, deliberate steps performed while in a trance state.
teaching.formation: Two main dancers (Ghatusari) perform the roles of the King and Queen.
teaching.rhythm: Rhythmic accompaniment provided by the Madal drum.
